annotation.evidence_span: limiting the window to the larger of 14720 bytes or twice the maximum datagram size
annotation.interpretation_a: If max_datagram_size is 7360 bytes or less, the congestion window is limited to 14720 bytes. If max_datagram_size is greater than 7360 bytes, the congestion window is limited to 2 * max_datagram_size.
annotation.interpretation_b: The congestion window is limited to the maximum of 14720 bytes and 2 * max_datagram_size, regardless of the value of max_datagram_size. The phrase 'the larger of' could be read as a single maximum value.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'the larger of 14720 bytes or twice the maximum datagram size' is open to interpretation. Does it mean the maximum of the two values, or does it imply a sequential application of the limits?
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the limit applies to both conditions simultaneously (the larger of the two results) or sequentially (first apply the 14720 byte limit, then the 2 * max_datagram_size limit). This affects the actual congestion window size.
